# NetFrame

> Cyberpunk CSS component library by Cybear Technologies. Plain CSS with `nf-` classes and `--nf-*` tokens, seven palettes, self-hosted fonts, no JavaScript runtime. npm package: `netframe`.

Install: `npm install netframe`, then `import 'netframe/dist/netframe.css'` (optional: `netframe/dist/themes.css`).

## Reference for agents

- [Full reference (usage, theming, interactive patterns, every class and token)](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Agent skills (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex)](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/agents/)

## Guides

- [Getting started](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/getting-started/): install, imports, Sass, fonts
- [Theming](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/theming/): tokens and alternate themes

## Components

- [Accordion](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/accordion/): Expand and collapse content sections.
- [Alert](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/alert/): Persistent callouts, feedback, and form-error summaries.
- [Avatar](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/avatar/): User profile images with status indicators.
- [Badge](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/badge/): Compact status labels and notification indicators.
- [Breadcrumb](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/breadcrumb/): Hierarchical path navigation.
- [Button](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/button/): Trigger actions and navigate. Five variants, three sizes.
- [Card](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/card/): Surface containers with header, body, and footer sections.
- [Divider](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/divider/): Structural horizontal and vertical separators.
- [Drawer](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/drawer/): Slide-in panels from the left or right edge.
- [Dropdown](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/dropdown/): Contextual menus anchored to a trigger element.
- [Input group](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/input-group/): Attached addons and actions composing native form controls.
- [Input](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/input/): Text inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios, and range sliders.
- [Modal](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/modal/): Focused dialogs that block the page.
- [Pagination](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/pagination/): Page navigation for large datasets.
- [Progress](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/progress/): Progress bars and rings for async operations.
- [Skeleton](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/skeleton/): Loading placeholder shimmer blocks.
- [Spinner](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/spinner/): Animated loading indicators.
- [Switch](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/switch/): Native on/off settings with keyboard and form behavior.
- [Table](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/table/): Data tables with sortable headers and row states.
- [Tabs](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/tabs/): Horizontal tab navigation.
- [Tag](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/tag/): Closable chip / tag elements.
- [Toast](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/toast/): Non-blocking notification messages.
- [Tooltip](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/components/tooltip/): Short contextual text on hover or focus.

## Utilities

- [Glitch](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/utilities/glitch/): RGB-split glitch animation utilities.
- [Glow](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/utilities/glow/): Pixel-offset shadows, ambient glows, and text glow utilities.
- [Layout](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/utilities/layout/): Flex, text, color, and border layout helper utilities.
- [Scanlines](https://netframe.cybeartech.com/utilities/scanlines/): CRT scanline overlay and pixel grid texture utilities.
